aboutMe.subtitle: Hello!
aboutMe.content: Nice to meet you!, I'm Fabian Stiven Valencia Cordoba

aboutMe.subtitle: Profession
aboutMe.content: I am a Systems Engineer, Professor, Developer, 3D Modeler, UX Designer, and Researcher

aboutMe.subtitle: Passion
aboutMe.content: I'm passionate about Web 2D/3D, Metaverses, Extended Reality (AR, MR, VR), 2D/3D prototyping, 3D modeling, and game development

aboutMe.subtitle: Education
aboutMe.content: I have a degree in Systems Engineering from Universidad del Valle (CO), with a laureate thesis

aboutMe.subtitle: Education
aboutMe.content: I have a degree in Systems Technology from Universidad del Valle (CO)

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I am currently a Researcher at Universidad del Valle (CO) in the Camaleón Research Group, focusing on Extended Reality (AR, MR, VR), Web 3D, 3D Modeling, and Metaverses

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a part-time professor at Universidad del Valle (CO) in the 2024-1 semester, teaching courses such as Integrative Project I, Video Game Development, Fundamentals of Event-Driven Programming, and Web Applications and Wireless Networks

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Service Technician at Universidad del Valle (CO) to provide technical support for the specialized training diploma 'Specialized training, good practices in the use of Science, Technology, and Innovation and Technological Transfer'

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Support Professional in the PMO coordination of the project 'Strengthening business competitiveness through the use of STI as a cross-cutting development tool in the Valle del Cauca department'

projects.subtitle: EISC Metaverse
projects.content: It is a metaverse developed for the School of Systems and Computing Engineering at Universidad del Valle, allowing real-time interaction in a Web 3D environment among students, professors, and the general community

projects.subtitle: DomoGallery
projects.content: It is a first-person Web 3D virtual space, where a dome presents an aerial view of the Universidad del Valle (CO) campus and an art gallery displays self-created poetry works

projects.subtitle: Portfolio Fabian Valencia
projects.content: This portfolio was developed in Web 3D to showcase my professional profile, projects, skills, and research outcomes

projects.subtitle: Art Gallery
projects.content: This art gallery is a Web 3D virtual space, resulting from research on how to develop in Three.js and Cannon.js, integrate an avatar, and model with Blender using UV Wrapping and Baking

projects.subtitle: AR Products
projects.content: Prototype to showcase products in augmented reality, developed in Unity using Google's ARCore

projects.subtitle: AR Machine
projects.content: Prototype of an electric machine to help Electronic Engineering students learn how the electromagnetic field works. This project was developed in Unity using Google's ARCore
